name: LookAtTargetFinder
src_typeComment: Plug-and-play "what am I currently looking at" query — continuously raycasts from screen-center (crosshair-style) or straight out from this Transform's forward, and fires OnTargetChanged whenever the answer changes. Different from Toolkit.Combat.RangedAttack's hitscan (a one-shot "fire now" action) — this is a STANDING query, the thing you'd drive an interaction prompt, an aim-assist highlight, or a "look at an NPC to see their nameplate" UI from.

src_serialized.name: sourceCamera
src_serialized.tooltip: Defaults to Camera.main if left empty.

src_serialized.name: useScreenCenter
src_serialized.tooltip: If true, raycasts from the center of the screen (a first/third-person crosshair). If false, raycasts from this Transform's own position/forward instead (e.g. a turret, or a VR headset's gaze).
